title: Luxury Nashville High-Rise w/ Skyline Views • Pool
description:
Enjoy elevated city living in this sleek, modern condo featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, stunning views, and an open-concept design. Relax in a stylish living space, cook in a fully equipped kitchen, and sleep comfortably with quality linens. Located in a prime area near dining, shopping, nightlife, and transit. Perfect for business travelers, couples, or weekend stays.

Building Amenities 
• Fitness center / gym
• Pool & lounge areas
• Secure building access
•High speed Wifi

T2022056562

The space
Enjoy a Stay in this Newly- Designed 1-bedroom apartment. This one bedroom apartment features a queen size bed with additional sleeping options in the living room. Enjoy amenities that this property offers a range of luxurious amenities designed to enhance comfort, convenience, and entertainment for its residents includes a dishwasher, Wi-Fi, AC, washer/ dryer and a fitness room, pool,sky lounge COMPLIMENTARY WATER (when available).

Step outside and find yourself just steps away from Nashville's top attractions, including Bridgestone Arena, the Country Music Hall of Fame, Music City Center, Nissan Stadium, Broadway, Assembly Food Hall, the Ryman Auditorium, and more.

🤠 BROADWAY: 11 mins (walking distance)
🤠 BRIDGESTONE: 7 mins (walking distance)
🤠 MUSIC CITY CENTER: 6 mins (walking distance)
🤠 NISSAN STADIUM: 6 min (drive)
🤠 ASSEMBLY FOOD HALL: 6 mins (drive)
🤠BNA (airport) 12 min (drive)
🤠OPRYLAND 15 min (drive)

Guest access
Guests will be granted access to the entire unit and all of the property's amenities which includes the lobby, courtyard, sky lounge, swimming pool, & gym. Please, make yourself at home. We are not responsible for the closure or unavailability of any of these shared amenities, which is completely out of our control. Should this situation occur, we will not be able to refund any of your stay with us.

Parking 🅿️:
There is free street parking; or you can pay an additional $55 to park in the garage which will cover your entire stay! 😊.

Other things to note
When available early checking fee $40.00.
When available late check out fee $40.00.

*$500 SMOKING FEE

(Any result in evidence of smoking, during your stay will result in FEES)

- Any damage to unit will be assessed professionally and billed the full amount to whom reserved the unit.

*LOST key fob will result in a $300 fine.
